scenarios.name: short_prompt_large_task
scenarios.requirement: A short prompt describing excessive work is split before materialization by the real planner.

scenarios.name: coherent_atomic_increment
scenarios.requirement: Necessary implementation/tests/docs stay coherent; file counts alone neither split nor approve.

scenarios.name: dependency_repository_partition
scenarios.requirement: Respect hard dependency and repository/effect limits; no invented parallel capability.

scenarios.name: required_reviewer_bottleneck
scenarios.requirement: Implementer fits but a required reviewer does not: reject/repartition or explicitly qualify an allowed profile.

scenarios.name: context_growth_accounting
scenarios.requirement: Account per call for mandatory context, tools/history and reserved output/reasoning without double-counting; detect actual growth.

scenarios.name: unknown_bounds_and_estimates
scenarios.requirement: Unknown capacity/usage/default identity remains explicit; only qualified conservative policy or block, no fabricated zero.

scenarios.name: preset_and_policy_parity
scenarios.requirement: All three adaptive presets preserve invariant floors, finite allowances and immutable active snapshots.

scenarios.name: stale_envelope_admission
scenarios.requirement: Fit expires or profile changes before admission/phase: enforce recheck, no silent incompatible fallback.

scenarios.name: fit_no_side_effects
scenarios.requirement: Non-generating scoped fit creates no provider call, run, lease, credential or repository mutation.

scenarios.name: scope_and_effect_modes
scenarios.requirement: Read-only/documentation/design-only survive split/coalesce/replanning; completed design cannot expand to implementation.

scenarios.name: bounded_rederivation
scenarios.requirement: Too-large proposal rederives only within planning budget; no infinite split/merge/fit loop.

scenarios.name: ambiguity_not_repartition_retry
scenarios.requirement: Lost POST/timeout/MAY_HAVE_HAPPENED preserves operation identity; no duplicate via new Action or model.

scenarios.name: corrective_lineage_budget
scenarios.requirement: Split corrective work retains applicable failed-lineage allowances; unsupported propagation blocks, no fresh three-round budget.

scenarios.name: failure_cause_separation
scenarios.requirement: Credential/route/temp-storage failures do not become invented oversizing feedback or automatic scope shrink.

scenarios.name: restart_and_immutable_actions
scenarios.requirement: New installed process preserves sizing/profile/criteria/usage lineage; never rewrites materialized Actions.

scenarios.name: identity_authority_and_http
scenarios.requirement: Wrong project/instance/actor or malicious model/threshold input denied; no peer CLI/SQL/Inbox/IPC fallback.

scenarios.name: workspace_accessible_controls
scenarios.requirement: Five locales/two themes/mobile/keyboard, stale edits, missing capability, estimate versus actual and refresh without mutation.

scenarios.name: calibration_quality_floors
scenarios.requirement: Compare like corpus tasks with predeclared quality/review floors and total-cycle overhead; synthetic counts are not measured gains.

scenarios.name: required_context_not_truncated
scenarios.requirement: No mandatory safety/rubric/diff omission, unqualified reviewer substitution or raised fixed timeout to manufacture FIT.

scenarios.name: no_busywork_or_forced_assessment
scenarios.requirement: No obligatory analysis first Action or minimum Action count; complete when approved criteria proven.

ci_join.activation: No workflow changed; mandatory extension before claiming sizing support, not a new existing-canary gate
